item.title: PREVALENT CRIME: Two arrested in connection with dozens of vehicle thefts across Hertfordshire
item.description: Two men have been arrested in connection with dozens of motor vehicle thefts across Hertfordshire worth more than £500,000. The arrests follow a long-running investigation into organised thefts of high-value vehicles using specialist equipment to bypass keyless vehicle security systems. item.description: A woodland path at Rickmansworth Aquadrome which has been closed for nearly two years is now one step closer to reopening.
